Khemthit doesn't like this bar, but when he meets ‘Vela', a university colleague and also a top host here, he's fascinated and wants to open his heart to him and this profession. Nevertheless, because of social status differences, this love story is not easy, and both of them need to prove this belief altogether. Still, Madame Freya can't open her heart to accept that her son falls in love with her employee and has ‘Meiji', her best friend, besides her to go through difficult times. Khemthit must prove both his mother and Vela, and he has to start working from the lowest position.

name: Brewster the Rooster
summary:
Brewster the Rooster and his best pal Maggie are both super inquisitive. They wear tap shoes but it's their inimitable style of imagining possible answers to questions that makes them such a good team!

Whenever one of them ponders a question like "If fish live in water, what do they drink?", Brewster and Maggie hold hands, do a little tap dance and open their imaginations. Through creative thinking, they come up with many possible solutions, always building on each other's ideas. They will take young viewers on a journey of discovery, and delve into a colourful and exciting world to find out the answers to those curious questions.

name: Hard Quiz Kids
summary: Tom Gleeson is launching a new edition of his hit show, Hard Quiz, for kids, featuring the same grumpy humour and intense questioning, but with contestants aged 10 to 13.

previousepisode.name: Dungeon and Dragons, the Inca Empire, Lilo and Stitch & Modern Family

name: Lust Stories
summary: Four stories that shed light on modern relationships from the viewpoint of the Indian woman, from strained marriages to sexual hiccups.

name: Dream Productions
summary: At the studio inside Riley's mind, a dream director faces a nightmare: creating the next hit dream.

name: Jaguar Journals
summary:
Jaguar Journals follows expert wildlife biologist and TV personality, Lizzie Daly as she joins groundbreaking monitoring projects. Using the latest tagging-technology, Lizzie uncovers exciting new insights into animal behavior and reveals how to protect wildlife. Jaguar Journals combines emotional and dramatic storytelling with the scientific purpose of Lizzie's mission across the series.

Each episode returns to the leading cast of jaguar characters in gripping storylines that keep the audience coming back for more.

name: Cursed Histories
summary:
You don't have to believe, but you should beware... Unravelling the histories and legends that unleashed a wave of misfortune into the world, these tales of intrigue, heartbreak, and deception are so tragic people still speak of the sinister forces surrounding the cursed. Learn how one misstep can set off a ripple of suffering.

From the tomb of Tutankhamen to the Hope Diamond to the Lost City of Frenier, history is riddled with people, places, and objects that spread utterly wicked, unbridled chaos. In the wake of death and disaster, how did these curses come to be? Whose wrath is responsible? What's the truth behind the unlucky? And can anyone ever hope to contain it?

previousepisode.name: The Missing Amber Room, Curse of Ifrit, Curse of the Crying Boy

name: The Life & Murder of Nicole Brown Simpson
summary: Nicole Brown Simpson's sisters and closest friends break their silence about her murder and O.J. Simpson's controversial trial, aiming to shed light on the truth.

name: Football Cops
summary: Behind the scenes with the cops working to stop trouble at matches, from England games to the Premier League and below.

name: The Hospital: Life on the Line
summary:
It doesn't matter who you are, each of has only one heart - and if it stops, so do you. In this dramatic and emotional new series, we're going inside the pioneering NHS Golden Jubilee Hospital in Clydebank, near Glasgow, to follow dedicated staff as they mend hearts, physically and metaphorically, providing a lifeline to patients and their loved ones in the toughest of times.

Right now, heart disease is still one of Britain's biggest killers, taking one person every three minutes - but here there is hope, warmth and love. This place is literally all heart.

name: El último día
summary: The unbelievable story of an alleged attempted mass suicide in Spain – and whether the resulting police raid was a bid to save lives… or a set-up.

name: The Miracle Department
summary: Based on a real Catholic organization, ‘The Miracle Department' is a heartfelt, comedic, hour-long series about a brilliant, but disgraced, former FBI agent who joins forces with a quirky task force to hunt for genuine miracles.

name: Bad Cop
summary: Twin brothers on the opposite sides of the law get caught in a complex web of deceit, loyalty and betrayal.

name: Jehanabad - Of Love & War
summary: Jehanabad - Of Love & War, set in 2005, is inspired by India's biggest jailbreak and focuses on how political motives coupled with violence can disrupt tender human relationships. Innocent love and intense violence clash in the small town of Jehanabad when an unlikely couple crosses paths with a seasoned Naxal commander and an ex-MLA with an agenda. Amidst the turmoil and destruction, will conflict triumph or will love prevail?
